names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 26 noiembrie, «Sfântul Cuvios Alipie Stâlpnicul», with the rank word left off.

Read out of saint.gr's line for 26 Νοεμβρίου, «Όσιος Αλύπιος ο Κιονίτης», with the rank word left off; «ο Κιονίτης», the pillar-man, is the page's own epithet and is left out of the stored form because the folder's `types` carry it.

The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 137, «Преподобный Алипий Столпник, Адрианопольский», with the rank word left off. The day line itself declines the name and gives only «Алипия столпника», so the by-name of Adrianople is read from the name page and not from the line.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 26. новембар ст. ст., „Преп. Алимпије Столпник.“ — «Преп.» is Преподобни, the `venerable` grade this folder already keeps, and «Столпник» is Столпник, the `stylite` grade it also keeps, so both rank words come off and the heading prints nothing else; Adrianople and Paphlagonia are in the body. Measured before it was written: no other folder in the corpus holds this string and it joins no fold. It is the Serbian vernacular form of the name the Russian calendar writes «Алипий» and the Greek «Αλύπιος», and it is not folded towards either, both of which this folder already carries.

feast.note: His two life pages both head themselves «День памяти: 26 ноября» and give no other day, so the calendar keeps him on this one day alone.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 26 ноября ст. ст. — «Прп. Алипия столпника (640).»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 26 noiembrie — «Sfântul Cuvios Alipie Stâlpnicul»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 26ης Νοεμβρίου — «Όσιος Αλύπιος ο Κιονίτης»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/3097/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 26 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους» and «Οσιος Αλυπιος ο Κιονιτης (; - 608)», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the man is the folder's own stylite. A death interval is proposed from the page's own year where the folder had none; **no birth interval is proposed**, because the page gives his age at death hedged three ways — «αφού έζησε 100 χρόνια, κατ' άλλους 120» — and the arithmetic is not this reader's to do. The hymn taken is the page's Κοντάκιον, which names him and no other saint and carries both an ἦχος and a model; its first Ἀπολυτίκιον in Ἦχος α’ names him but has no model, and the Κάθισμα is neither a troparion nor a kontakion, so neither is drafted, and the page's «Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον» was read only in part and is not drafted either. The page adds his head at Koutloumousiou on Athos and a portion at the Kyriakon of the Skete of Kausokalyvia, and a synaxis «ἐν τῇ μονῇ αὐτοῦ τῇ οὔσῃ πλησίον τοῦ Ἱπποδρομίου» on the authority of the Paris Codex 1594. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 09.12.2025 (26. новембар ст. ст.) — „Преп. Алимпије Столпник.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, and the longest of the five. `dates` UNTOUCHED, and the reason is the whole of this note’s difficulty: the book says «Преживевши 100 година упокоји се 640. год. у време цара Ираклија» — a hundred years lived and the repose in 640 — where this folder holds a birth of 522 from the Russian calendar and a death of «608 or 640», the two years two calendars give. THE BOOK AGREES WITH THE LATER END, 640, AND IT WOULD CLOSE THE INTERVAL; it is NOT closed, because an interval that records a disagreement between two books is not settled by a third agreeing with one of them, and the folder’s own note says so. THE AGE DISAGREES BESIDES: a hundred years against the folder’s birth of 522 would put the repose about 622, and the Russian life this folder quotes makes him 118 at his death in 640. A hundred, a hundred and eighteen, and saint.gr’s «100 χρόνια, κατ’ άλλους 120» — three ages, and no reader may pick among them. ONE `related` row added, the reverse half of the third entry’s: the book makes `stelian-the-paphlagonian` his countryman and his contemporary. WHAT THE ENTRY ADDS: his birth at Adrianople in Paphlagonia and his being given to God’s service from childhood; his deaconate in the church of that city under its bishop; THE HEATHEN GRAVEYARD OUTSIDE THE WALLS THAT PEOPLE FLED AS A HAUNTED PLACE, where he planted a cross and built a church to the great martyr who had appeared to him in a dream; FIFTY-THREE FULL YEARS ON THE PILLAR beside it; the demons who threw stones at him and gave him no peace day or night, and who at the last were beaten and fled; the two monasteries that rose round the pillar, a men’s on one side and a women’s on the other, with his own mother and sister in the women’s; his guiding of both from the pillar by word and example; THE COLUMN OF HEAVENLY LIGHT THAT WOULD RISE FROM HIM TO THE SKY; and his head, kept at the monastery of Koutloumousiou on the Holy Mountain. NOT IDENTIFIED and no row written: the bishop under whom he served as deacon is named in the book, and the corpus holds no folder this reader could join to him.

hymns.text: Al răbdării stâlp ai fost, râvnind părinţilor celor mai dinainte, cuvioase, Sfântului Iov întru patimi, Sfântului Iosif întru ispite şi vieţii celor fără de trup, fiind în trup, Sfinte Alipie, părintele nostru. Roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Cuvios Alipie Stâlpnicul

english.text: You were a pillar of patience, venerable father, emulating the fathers of old — Saint Job in his sufferings, Saint Joseph in his temptations, and the life of the bodiless powers while yet in the body, holy Alypius our father. Pray to Christ God to save our souls.

hymns.text: Ὡς ἀρετῶν ὑπόθεσιν, καὶ Ἀσκητῶν καλλώπισμα, ἡ Ἐκκλησία δοξάζει σε σήμερον, καὶ ἀνυμνεῖ σε Ἀλύπιε· ταῖς εὐχαῖς σου παράσχου, τοῖς τιμῶσιν ἐκ πόθου τὰς ἀριστείας σου, καὶ τὰ παλαίσματα, τῶν δεινῶν ἐγκλημάτων ἐκλύτρωσιν, ὡς ἐπώνυμος.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος πλ. δ’, Ὡς ἀπαρχὰς τῆς φύσεως — on the page of «Όσιος Αλύπιος ο Κιονίτης». It names him and no other saint, and plays at the end on his name, ἐπώνυμος, the one true to it — Alypius meaning the man who never grieves.

english.text: As a ground of the virtues and an adornment of ascetics, the Church glorifies you today and sings your praise, Alypius. By your prayers grant to those who honour with longing your excellences and your wrestlings a deliverance from grievous offences, as one true to your name.

hymns.text: Терпения столп был еси,/ ревновавый праотцем, преподобне,/ Иову во страстех, Иосифу во искушениих,/ и Безплотных жительству, сый в телеси,/ Алипие отче наш,// моли Христа Бога спастися душам нашим.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 26 ноября ст. ст. — «Тропарь преподобного Алипия (глас 1)»

english.text: You were a pillar of patience, venerable father, emulating the forefathers of old — one in his sufferings and one in his temptations — and the life of the bodiless powers while yet in the body. Alypius our father, pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Страшен и неприступен показался еси бесом воистину,/ уязвляя сих раною священных твоих молитв/ и далече отгоняя ополчения страстная постом/ и колеблющимся был еси, всеблаженне, непреклонное утверждение,/ Алипие преподобне,/ моли Христа Бога/ спастися душам нашим.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 26 ноября ст. ст. — «Ин тропарь преподобного Алипия (глас 4)»

english.text: Truly you were shown to be terrible and unapproachable to the demons, wounding them with the stroke of your holy prayers and driving the armies of the passions far off by fasting; and to the wavering, all-blessed one, you were an unbending support. Venerable Alypius, pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Яко добродетелей вину и постников удобрение,/ Церковь славит тя днесь и воспевает, Алипие:/ молитвами твоими подаждь чтущим любовию доблести твоя и борения/ лютых прегрешений избавление,// яко тезоименитый.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 26 ноября ст. ст. — «Кондак преподобного Алипия (глас 8)»

english.text: As a ground of the virtues and an adornment of ascetics, the Church glorifies you today and sings your praise, Alypius. By your prayers grant deliverance from grievous transgressions to those who honour your valour and your wrestlings with love — you who are true to your name.

birth.note: days.pravoslavie.ru's first life for him opens «Преподобный Алипий Столпник родился в 522 году в г. Адрианополе в Пафлогонии». No other calendar read gives him a year of birth at all; saint.gr says outright that its page gives none.

death.note: Two calendars, two years, and nothing read breaks the tie. saint.gr heads his page «Οσιος Αλυπιος ο Κιονιτης (; - 608)» and its narrative closes «Πέθανε ειρηνικά το έτος 608 μ.Χ., αφού έζησε 100 χρόνια, κατ' άλλους 120» — died in peace in 608, having lived a hundred years, or by other accounts a hundred and twenty. days.pravoslavie.ru carries two lives for him on 26 ноября and both close on 640: «Почил преподобный Алипий в 640 г., в возрасте 118 лет». The Russian reading is the one that adds up against its own year of birth, 522, and 118 is within a couple of years of saint.gr's own alternative age; but the year is not the same year, so the interval carries both and nothing is chosen.
